editorial_thesis: The valuable agent signal is shifting from model novelty to operating design: durable execution, governed delivery, workspace context, and outcome measurement.

topic_groups.title: Enterprise Agent Delivery
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh regulated-workflow evidence and an enterprise platform announcement make delivery governance more actionable than another generic model roundup.

sources.title: IBM and Microsoft announce Imagine Enterprise
sources.why_selected: New platform combines 6,000+ reusable assets with identity, governance, security, and observability.
sources.usefulness: Provides a blueprint for packaging Buildn/client agent delivery as a governed operating capability.

sources.title: Northern Trust and Microsoft client onboarding agent
sources.why_selected: Reports a concrete transformation workflow with 83% less preparation time and 96.5% first-pass F1.
sources.usefulness: Offers a practical scorecard for measuring automation quality, exceptions, and human review.

topic_groups.title: Agent Execution Infrastructure
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Coverage memory has emphasized models repeatedly; today shifts to the runtime primitives that make long-running agents reliable and economically testable.

sources.title: Introducing the Agents API
sources.why_selected: Makes sessions, compaction, tool search, subagents, artifacts, and selectable sandboxes explicit API primitives.
sources.usefulness: Maps directly to scheduled research, QA, and delivery workflows that need recovery and inspectable outputs.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Carbon is now available
sources.why_selected: A new Google source introduces a deep-reasoning tier and swarm workflow for difficult, long-horizon tasks.
sources.usefulness: Supports a task-based routing experiment instead of making the most expensive model the default.

topic_groups.title: Outcome-First Customer Workflows
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Business software is an under-covered lane and this release connects workspace-aware actions, live model outputs, and multi-touch goals in one product surface.

sources.title: Customer.io’s biggest product release: AI Agent and more
sources.why_selected: Adds a workspace-aware AI Agent, LLM Actions inside journeys, and Goals for outcome measurement.
sources.usefulness: Provides a portable pattern for agents that act inside a system of record with review and measurable outcomes.
